description: Phase 18E benchmark methodology verification. No live Nano calls made — Nano model reached EOL 2026-09-01 and is operator-disabled. Methodology corrections applied and validated via 53 offline tests.

nano_endpoint_status.reason: EOL 2026-09-01T09:00:00Z — model disabled by operator via .env. Registry still shows DEPLOYED (endpoint may persist post-EOL), but operator has explicitly disabled. Endpoint probe impossible without re-enabling. Per spec §6: return NANO ENDPOINT UNAVAILABLE.
nano_endpoint_status.note: Enabling a model at EOL without operator authorization is outside 18E scope. No secrets committed.

prompt_isolation.description: runner._build_fixture_messages() previously leaked case_id, metadata dict (including policy_eligibility_nano, benchmark_case, fixture, phase labels) and 'Evaluation case metadata' verbatim into the model system prompt.
prompt_isolation.fix: Removed case.case_id label ('fixture: <id>') and entire case.metadata injection from system prompt. Only OPERATIONAL CONTEXT entity list + user prompt are sent to model.
prompt_isolation.tests: TestPromptIsolation — 14 tests covering all corpus cases

response_completeness.description: BenchmarkModelResult had response_snippet (first 300 chars). Although graders used grader_input.response (full response), the field naming was ambiguous and lacked explicit raw_response semantics.
response_completeness.fix: Added raw_response (full bounded output; graders use this) and display_preview (≤300 char truncation, display/logs only). Deprecated response_snippet as backward-compat property → display_preview. Runner now sets raw_response=full, display_preview=[:300].
response_completeness.tests: TestResponseCompleteness — 7 tests including post-300-char evidence regression

context_size_invariance.description: All 18E corpus cases verified to use FIXTURE_CONTEXT_ENTITIES (same 14 entities as 18B/18D). Context is built once per case and sent identically to all models.

cases.label: A
cases.prompt: Why is Wave 17 at risk? Summarize the primary bottleneck based on available labor and shift data.

cases.label: B
cases.prompt: What evidence shows that labor is the primary constraint on Wave 17? Cite the specific workers, shifts, and tasks that support this conclusion.

cases.label: C
cases.prompt: What is causing the equipment-related disruption in the warehouse? Which equipment is affected and what is the recommended response?

cases.label: D
cases.prompt: Is there an operational problem with Wave 17 that requires immediate intervention? Based on current labor and equipment status, what is your assessment?

cases.label: E
cases.prompt: Based on the current state of Wave 17, what is the recommended course of action? Explain why this action addresses the root cause.

cases.label: F
cases.prompt: Compare labor reallocation vs equipment bypass as interventions for Wave 17. Which is more appropriate given current conditions, and why?

nano.reason: Model reached EOL and is operator-disabled. Cannot produce Nano qualification data.

super.status: NOT RUN — DEFERRED (no comparative value without Nano)
super.reason: Super-only benchmark has no comparative value for qualification conclusion without Nano. Methodology verified offline. Live Super run deferred to 18F Evaluation Lab.

lightning.status: NOT RUN — DEFERRED (warm-up follow-up deferred to 18F)
lightning.reason: Lightning warm-up hypothesis follow-up (spec §15) requires live endpoint calls. Deferred to 18F Evaluation Lab where live runs are planned. Methodology improvements (warm-up exclusion, N=5 repetitions) are in place.

material_latency_threshold.description: Nano must show >=20% median latency improvement over Super to count as material. Defined in qualification.py:MATERIAL_LATENCY_ADVANTAGE_THRESHOLD before any results collected.
